say:0:1560218001:0.text: It's a go-lamb corn! Chippy's onto you now!
say:0:1560218001:0.source_cn: 是巨型魔偶的核心！终于找到你了！

say:1:1560218002:0.text: This was powering the golem, but it's already drained.
say:1:1560218002:0.source_cn: 就是它在为魔偶供能，但这颗的能量已经被吸收了。

say:2:1560218003:0.text: It's fine. Let's focus on locating and destroying the other cores!
say:2:1560218003:0.source_cn: 不要紧，我们尽快摧毁其他核心吧！
say:2:1560218003:0.male: It's fine. Let's focus on locating and destroying the other cores!
say:2:1560218003:0.female: It's fine. Let's focus on locating and destroying the other cores!
